statements.markdown: To pass to larger bases, note that for $0\le r<d$ the function $(b^r-1)/(b^d-1)$ is nonincreasing on $b>1$. For $r>0$ we cancel $b-1$ and write it as $A(b)/(A(b)+C(b))$, where $A(b)=\sum_{i<r}b^i$ and $C(b)=\sum_{r\le j<d}b^j$; its derivative has the sign of $A'C-AC'=\sum_{i<r\le j<d}(i-j)b^{i+j-1}<0$. Hence $\Delta_{b,A}(N)\le\Delta_{2,A}(N)$ for every real $b\ge2$
